name: rolepod-brain
description: Persistent memory for AI coding agents. Captures your sessions, consolidates them into a searchable markdown wiki, and hands the next session a short list of pointers. One binary, nothing resident.

interface.shortDescription: Session memory that survives context wipes. No daemon, no API keys.
interface.longDescription: Captures Codex lifecycle events, consolidates them with the cheap tier of a CLI you are already signed into, and injects pointers - never content - into later sessions. Requires the `brain` binary on PATH (see the repository README). Nothing runs in the background: hooks spawn a short-lived worker, the MCP server lives one session, and consolidation is triggered by session boundaries.
